t_advice_summary_textbox.text: They think the colours are irrelevant. They think you should press S until the numbers start dropping, then press K and until those numbers start dropping too.

vb_textbox.text: I received advice that said press K until the amount is low, then press S until low and so on.  I didn't find this the case with my experience.  I was getting a consistent higher mark with K on the first round then a higher mark with S on the second round.
